range.title: Date range
range.description: Which dates to return, in US Eastern time. Pick "custom" to set your own start and end dates below.

startDate.title: Start date (custom range)
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only used when Date range is "Custom dates".

endDate.title: End date (custom range)
endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only used when Date range is "Custom dates".

impactLevels.title: Impact levels
impactLevels.description: High: jobs report (NFP), CPI, GDP, PCE, retail sales, FOMC decisions. Medium: PPI, JOLTS, housing starts, durable goods, trade, Treasury note/bond auctions. Low: everything else.

sources.title: Agencies
sources.description: Which official calendars to include. All are selected by default.

enumTitles: Census: retail sales, housing, durable goods
Treasury: bill, note and bond auctions

keyword.title: Keyword filter
keyword.description: Only return releases whose title contains this text, e.g. "price index" or "GDP". Leave empty for all.
